title: A Big Bet on Explosive AI-Driven Growth - Marginal REVOLUTION
gist: Alex Tabarrok highlights a $300k wager on whether US real GDP per capita will grow at least 15% in a single year by end-2033; the no-fast-growth side stakes $240k against $60k at 4:1 odds (implied 20% probability of explosive AI-driven growth), with Tabarrok siding against the fast-growth scenario.

insights.claim: A wager agreed on X in August 2026 turns on whether US real GDP per capita grows at least 15% within a single year (relative to prior peak) by end-2033.
insights.speaker: Alex Tabarrok
insights.so_what: Defines a concrete, dated threshold for 'explosive' AI growth that investors can benchmark macro forecasts against.
insights.quote: whether U.S. real GDP per capita will grow by at least 15% within a single year (measured relative to prior peak) by the end of 2033
insights.locator: A bet on near-term explosive AI-driven growth

insights.claim: The bet's 4:1 odds ($60k fast-growth side vs $240k no-fast-growth side) imply just a 20% probability of the explosive-growth scenario among the participants.
insights.speaker: Alex Tabarrok
insights.so_what: A market-style implied probability from informed participants for AI transforming aggregate growth this decade.
insights.quote: Implied probability of the fast-growth scenario: 20%.

insights.claim: The largest single stake is Andrew Ho's $200,000 on the no-fast-growth side, and economist Ben Moll organized the bet betting against explosive growth.
insights.speaker: Alex Tabarrok
insights.so_what: Shows conviction size behind the skeptical side of the AI-growth debate.

insights.claim: Tabarrok says he would side with Moll, i.e. against near-term explosive AI-driven growth, while calling it a genuine and important disagreement.
insights.speaker: Alex Tabarrok
insights.so_what: A prominent techno-optimist economist nonetheless leans skeptical on explosive one-year growth by 2033.
insights.quote: I’d side with Moll, for what it is worth.
insights.locator: I’m known for quipping that a bet is a tax on bullshit
